notes.title: Release for New Patch 0.2!
notes.content:
This patch features:

[list]
[*] Tutorial Level
[*] Controller improvements.
[*] Controller support for Mac OS and more types of controllers such as PS4 and others.
[*] Platform fixes (reduced donut slipping, cracks between platforms, etc.)
[*] Dab Corner Hallways now have their color changed and function similarly to dab platforms.
[/list]
